signature: SUBROUTINE DGTCON( NORM, N, DL, D, DU, DU2, IPIV, ANORM, RCOND,

params.name: norm
params.reference:
Specifies whether the 1-norm condition number or the infinity-norm condition number is required: = '1' or 'O': 1-norm;

-   `= 'I'`: Infinity-norm.

params.name: N
params.reference: The order of the matrix A. $N \ge 0$.

params.name: DL
params.reference: The (n-1) multipliers that define the matrix L from the LU factorization of A as computed by DGTTRF.

params.name: d
params.reference: The n diagonal elements of the upper triangular matrix U from the LU factorization of A.

params.name: DU
params.reference: The (n-1) elements of the first superdiagonal of U.

params.name: DU2
params.reference: The (n-2) elements of the second superdiagonal of U.

params.name: IPIV
params.reference: The pivot indices; for $1 \le i \le n$, row i of the matrix was interchanged with row `IPIV(i)`. `IPIV(i)` will always be either i or i+1; `IPIV(i) = i` indicates a row interchange was not required.

params.name: anorm
params.reference: If `NORM = '1'` or 'O', the 1-norm of the original matrix A. If `NORM = 'I'`, the infinity-norm of the original matrix A.

params.name: rcond
params.reference: The reciprocal of the condition number of the matrix A, computed as $\mathrm{RCOND} = 1/(\mathrm{ANORM} \, \mathrm{AINVNM})$, where AINVNM is an estimate of the 1-norm of inv(A) computed in this routine.

params.name: info
params.reference:
-   `= 0`: successful exit
-   `< 0`: if `INFO = -i`, the i-th argument had an illegal value
